static_traits.name: Lin Siyan
static_traits.family_status: Lives alone in Los Angeles; family lives in Tokyo, separated from one another
static_traits.social_status: Having a few acquaintances in Los Angeles, but unwilling to discuss language unease with them
static_traits.medical_history: No prior history of psychotherapy, no major physical illness, and no similar psychological problems before coming to Los Angeles
static_traits.language_features: Able to clearly express and proactively share negative automatic thoughts; tone rather negative and anxious, tends toward avoidance; skeptical about goal setting but willing to try, cooperation acceptable

basic_info.main_problem: Since moving to Los Angeles, I feel inferior and incompetent because of my insufficient English; communication difficulties affect auditions and socializing, and I feel nervous and judged almost daily at work auditions and social occasions.
basic_info.core_demands: 'I just want to be able to speak confidently, no longer worrying about every small mistake. I hope to feel less insecure when I go to auditions, and to make friends here as well.'
growth_experiences: About 6 months ago, the client moved to Los Angeles to start a new life; the initial stress was great; afterward, due to English communication barriers, the client felt nervous and judged at auditions and in social settings, which also affected career development and self-esteem.

core_beliefs: I am not smart enough / not competent enough
My worth depends on others' evaluation of my English performance

special_situations.event: Needing to communicate and perform in English during auditions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my expression is not perfect or I make a mistake, I will fail completely and be rejected
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding or reducing auditions, speaking as little as possible to reduce the risk of making mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will mess all of this up; once I say something wrong I am finished

special_situations.event: Conversing in English with strangers or new friends at social gatherings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' views of me determine my value; if they do not understand me, it means I am stupid
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Spends time alone as much as possible and reduces social interaction to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am stupid / they will not understand me

special_situations.event: Reviewing the few successful English communication episodes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Occasional successes are just luck; they do not mean my ability has improved
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negates progress and continues self-criticism to maintain caution
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: That was just luck; it does not count as real progress

special_situations.event: Discussing or trying to set small goals for English practice
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail, it proves I cannot do it and am not smart enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids setting goals or lowers challenges to dodge failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Even for a very small goal I will fail, this will only prove I am no good

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be understood, accepted, and to communicate and perform confidently with people
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged and humiliated, fearing failure leading to career damage and rejection
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being judged and maintaining a sense of safety through avoidance and self-denial

object_relations.object_representation: A picky judge who would mock or negate oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites setting specific small goals or activity arrangements
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes that once they fail it proves they are 'incompetent', and worries that the counselor's suggestions may also be ineffective (skeptical of suggestions)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Centers on empathizing with and validating feelings, gently inquires about past evidence and exception experiences, proposes tiny, low-risk experimental goals, and uses supportive language to reduce failure anxiety.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When counseling explores others' views or social interaction
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Projects their own self-negation and insecurity as 'others will think I am stupid', regarding the outside world as a harsh judge
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintain a gentle and curious tone, use evidence examination and alternative explanations, invite comparisons of concrete examples, distinguish facts from speculation, and gradually rebuild the internal basis of self-evaluation.

manifestations: Living alone in Los Angeles, separated from family in Tokyo
Avoiding others in social situations for fear of being judged, lacking deep connection with others
Lacks supportive relationships in which to discuss language anxiety
outcomes: Damaged self-esteem and reduced sense of self-worth
Increased anxiety and feelings of shame

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: Avoids auditions and social interaction, practicing English alone instead
Pushing back the impulse to communicate with others and engaging in self-reproach and self-denial

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequently negates the self using failure as evidence (such as 'failure proves I am not capable')
Worrying excessively when setting goals and limiting challenges; overly cautious

exception_events.target_problem: In daily social or public communication situations, the client is usually nervous and avoidant due to lack of confidence in English, finding it hard to sustain conversation with others.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Had a few successful casual conversations, able to sustain exchange with markedly reduced shame, without immediately avoiding or falling into a negative cycle as usual.
exception_events.reason: Clues: the other party was relatively patient, the interaction atmosphere was friendlier and safer, so this time the client could express more smoothly and maintain the conversation.

positive_force: Willing to try setting tiny goals and practicing
A few successful English communication episodes exist that can serve as resources
Having a foundation from English courses and self-study
negative_force: Thinking patterns of catastrophizing and predicting failure
Mind reading and disqualifying the positive cause self-worth to over-rely on others' evaluation
Avoidant behavior toward socializing and auditions
Loneliness and a weak support system keep the negative cycle going

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids or reduces English communication at auditions and social occasions, accompanied by marked tension and anxiety
antecedent: Audition situations requiring expression and performance in English
Scenes of social gatherings or talking with strangers
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing cognitions about English not being perfect enough and predictions of failure, internalizing others' possible reactions as judgments of self-worth
target_behavior.function: Escaping the potential risk of being judged or humiliated, maintaining subjective safety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Career development is blocked, interpersonal relationships are hard to establish, loneliness worsens, and self-esteem is damaged

target_behavior.behavior: Recurring self-negating negative automatic thoughts (such as 'I will mess up' and 'they will think I am stupid')
antecedent: Before, during, or when reviewing English communication
When facing goal setting or practice arrangements
target_behavior.core_reason: Deep core belief 'I am not smart enough / not competent enough', maintained through overgeneralization and mind reading
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the shame of failure by lowering expectations and self-protection
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety is maintained or worsens, learning motivation declines, and further avoidance makes skills and confidence hard to improve
